"Having Morf is like having a personal trainer available 24/7. The AI coach understands exactly what I need and adapts to my schedule perfectly. I've never been more consistent!" - Shaayan T.

ADAPTS TO YOUR LIFE – Whether you have 20 minutes at home or an hour at the gym, Morf creates workouts that fit your schedule and space perfectly.
SHOWS YOUR REAL PROGRESS – Advanced analytics and strength percentile rankings let you see exactly how you're improving over time.

SMART WORKOUT GENERATION – AI creates custom workouts based on your history, preferences, and available time
COMPREHENSIVE PROGRESS TRACKING – Log exercises, track PRs, and visualize your strength journey with detailed analytics
MULTIPLE TRAINING STYLES – From bodyweight routines to powerlifting programs, Push/Pull/Legs splits to full-body workouts
EQUIPMENT-SMART PROGRAMMING – Workouts adapt to whatever you have available, from bodyweight-only to fully equipped gyms
REAL-TIME WORKOUT GUIDANCE – Precision timing, rest periods, and form reminders keep you on track
ACHIEVEMENT SYSTEM – Celebrate milestones, streak tracking, and personal records with rewarding feedback
INTELLIGENT PROGRESSION – Advanced models predict future PRs and plan your training cycles for optimal results
MORF is built for everyone who wants to see real progress and have fun doing it. We believe fitness should be engaging, rewarding, and accessible to all. Whether you're starting your fitness journey or chasing new PRs, MORF makes every workout count.

record.name: Ya Trini: AI Workout Tracker
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The gym buddy who never cancels. He's a lion.

Ya Trini builds your workout plan, shows you every exercise, and tracks your meals and calories. Zid, the lion cub coach, trains with you. Made in Morocco. In Darija, French and English.

"You hit the iron. I bring the roar." Zid

EVERY MOVE, SHOWN
Each exercise has a video or a photo, and clear steps: where your feet go, what you feel, what to avoid. Open it any time in your workout.

A PLAN IN A FEW TAPS
Answer a few questions: your goal, your level, your days, your equipment. You get a plan for your week, at the gym or at home. Change a workout, swap an exercise, or build your own routine.

MEALS AND CALORIES
Ya Trini works out your daily calories, protein, carbs and fat from your goal. Search a food, Moroccan dishes included, or scan a barcode. Count your water too.

LOG A SET IN ONE TAP
The app remembers your last weights and tells you what to aim for today. Beat your number and Zid says so. Loudly.

REST, THEN GO
Lock your phone. The rest timer keeps running, on the lock screen too. We tell you when to go again.

YOUR PROGRESS
Your records, a trend for each exercise, your training calendar, your week goal and your streak. Missed a week? A comeback week gets you going again.

ALSO
• Apple Health and Health Connect: your workouts are saved there
• Add a photo to your workout card and share it
• Works when the gym has no signal
• Need help? Write to us from the app

Coach is your always-ready personal trainer that designs the perfect workout for you—every time. Using intelligent AI, Coach adapts to your fitness level, goals, and recovery needs to craft workouts that maximize progress with minimal effort.

No more decision fatigue. No more cookie-cutter plans. Just science-backed, personalized training—built for your body and your schedule.

* Dynamic Programming: Never repeat the same routine—Coach evolves with you.

* Smart Adaptation: Real-time workout tweaks based on how you're feeling today.
* Clean, Dark Interface: Designed for focus. Looks as powerful as it feels.
* Streaks & Stats: Stay motivated with insights that actually matter.

Whether you’re training for strength, hypertrophy, endurance, or just getting started—Coach delivers the next best workout, without you lifting a finger (until you’re lifting weight).

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Once activated, you may only cancel your subscription ahead of the next annual term. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime by visiting Account Settings in your Apple Account after upgrading.

record.description_evidence:
Lumer is your AI-powered fitness and nutrition companion. Get a personalized workout and meal plan every single day - built around your body, goals, and dietary preferences.

Daily Workout Plans
Strength, cardio, HIIT, yoga, flexibility - Lumer creates the right workout for you based on your fitness level and goals. Each exercise comes with clear instructions, sets, reps, and form cues. Rest days are recommended automatically based on your training history.

Daily Nutrition Plans
Complete meal plans with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks. Every meal includes calorie estimates, protein targets, and a full ingredient list. Strictly follows your dietary preference - vegetarian, vegan, eggetarian, or non-vegetarian.

Adapt Your Plan Anytime
Sore, short on time, missing equipment? Tell Lumer in plain words and it rebuilds today's plan around you. Swap any single exercise the same way.

Track What You Do
Log workouts and meals, build a streak, and see your history and insights over time.

Lumer Premium
Lumer is free for 8 weeks, including 3 AI plan days per week. After that, Premium keeps AI plan generation, adapt, swap, and AI meal estimates unlocked. Logging, history, and your calendar stay free forever. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://lumer.app/terms

Privacy First
Your data stays on your device. No accounts. No sign-ups. Delete everything anytime from Settings.

"Other apps pick exercises from a list. DeepFit AI builds your entire program from scratch — around your injuries, your equipment, your schedule, and how your knee feels this morning."

DeepFit AI is a comprehensive AI Agent that manages your entire fitness journey. From day one, it communicates with you to understand your unique goals, breaks them into achievable steps, and designs plans specifically for you. Unlike other apps that reuse generic templates, DeepFit creates unique content for every single user — every workout, every modification, every recommendation is built around your body, your equipment, and your life.

BUILT FOR YOU
• Hyper-personalized workout plans based on YOUR goals, equipment, schedule, and physical limitations
• Integrated strength training, physical therapy, mobility, nutrition, and recovery in one place
• Works with ANY equipment — full gym, dumbbells in your garage, or just bodyweight
• Multiple workout locations supported (home gym, commercial gym, hotel, and more)

MEET TARA — YOUR AI COACH
• TARA (Training And Rehabilitation Assistant) is your 24/7 AI fitness coach
• Get tailored exercise tutorials for YOUR specific variations — not generic video banks
• Ask nutrition questions and get personalized dietary guidance
• Report injuries or daily conditions and get instantly adapted workouts

ADAPTS TO YOUR LIFE
• Learns from your progress, feedback, and history — automatically adjusting your plan
• Tweaked your knee? Tell DeepFit and get a modified workout in seconds
• Goals changed? Use Re-evaluate to update your plan anytime
• Perfect for beginners, athletes, and seasoned lifters alike

NOT ANOTHER TEMPLATE APP
DeepFit AI isn't a workout logger with a chatbot slapped on top. It's a proprietary intelligence system built on real human physiology by industry experts. It doesn't reuse programs. It doesn't hand you a PDF. It builds a living, evolving fitness plan that updates every time you finish a set.

DeepFit AI Pro is available as a monthly or annual subscription via our website. A free 14-day trial is available for new users. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your account settings.
